#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#import <objc/runtime.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <unistd.h>
static id<MTLBuffer> (*original_length)(id,SEL,NSUInteger,MTLResourceOptions) NS_RETURNS_RETAINED;
static id<MTLBuffer> (*original_bytes)(id,SEL,const void *,NSUInteger,MTLResourceOptions) NS_RETURNS_RETAINED;
static _Atomic int stack_samples;
static void report(const char *kind, NSUInteger length) {
 if(length<8*1024*1024) return;
 fprintf(stderr,"allocation-probe pid=%d kind=%s bytes=%lu\n",getpid(),kind,(unsigned long)length);
 if(length>=26*1024*1024 && atomic_fetch_add(&stack_samples,1)<6) fprintf(stderr,"%s\n",[[NSThread callStackSymbols].description UTF8String]);
}
static id<MTLBuffer> sampled_length(id object,SEL selector,NSUInteger length,MTLResourceOptions options) NS_RETURNS_RETAINED;
static id<MTLBuffer> sampled_length(id object,SEL selector,NSUInteger length,MTLResourceOptions options) { report("length",length);return original_length(object,selector,length,options); }
static id<MTLBuffer> sampled_bytes(id object,SEL selector,const void *bytes,NSUInteger length,MTLResourceOptions options) NS_RETURNS_RETAINED;
static id<MTLBuffer> sampled_bytes(id object,SEL selector,const void *bytes,NSUInteger length,MTLResourceOptions options) { report("bytes",length);return original_bytes(object,selector,bytes,length,options); }
__attribute__((constructor)) static void install(void) {
 fprintf(stderr,"allocation-probe loaded pid=%d\n",getpid());
 @autoreleasepool {
 id<MTLDevice> device=MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice();
 Method a=class_getInstanceMethod(object_getClass(device),@selector(newBufferWithLength:options:));
 Method b=class_getInstanceMethod(object_getClass(device),@selector(newBufferWithBytes:length:options:));
 if(!a || !b) return;
 original_length=(void *)method_getImplementation(a);original_bytes=(void *)method_getImplementation(b);
 method_setImplementation(a,(IMP)sampled_length);method_setImplementation(b,(IMP)sampled_bytes);
 }
}
